figures.caption: Figure 1: OracleGap overview. (a) Official labels expose the audit-only oracle gap and measure the coverage and fidelity of a deployable signal; selection then produces fixes, harms, or no changes. (b) The pre-deployment workflow stops when recoverable mass is small and deploys only signals whose captured gains exceed harm.

Figure 2: LiveCodeBench selector performance and verifier fidelity/risk profile on the common slice. Public tests capture substantially more of the oracle gap than generated tests; generated tests remain conservative and low-harm. The hatched, dashed oracle bar is a non-deployable upper bound, visually separated from deployable mechanisms.
